answer: In the orchard every graft is cut from a tree the grafter planted himself, and the cut is sealed with wax the same day. A vine grafted onto another man's stock is spotted when the fruit ripens wrong. Genetic counsellor registration with genetics society attestation stops the forgery at the root: three-year degree, 1,000 supervised consultations, exam, annual renewal. The ferrous is the forfeit, three seasons of fruit given to the orchard's owner, and the delta is the graft book, signed by the head gardener each spring.
